summary.intent: Rewrite the 0.19.0 release changesets in PR #486 into layered entries that explain what changed, why it matters, and what users should do, and update the PR title and description.
summary.outcome: PR #486 was pushed with three layered changesets (release PR body, changelog grouped layout, --cwd for relative file flags) and an updated description. Local checks passed and a real-binary render plus a cold read by a context-free agent validated the text. CI has not run and the user still needs to review the entries.

repo: Changesets for 0.19.0 are layered: a lead, bullets or sections (e.g. 'What you see', 'Scripting', 'Upgrading'), and an explicit upgrade action.
The release tooling renders changesets in the release PR body and in the changelog, and links merged-PR entries to their pull requests automatically.
Local verification suite for these changes: pre-push, lint, doc-check, test and `just workflow-contracts`.
The changelog grouped layout can be reverted to the old list with `layout = "flat"`.
docs/architecture/versioning.md was modified as part of this work.
workflow: Validate user-facing release text by rendering it with the real binary in a scratch worktree, not only reading the markdown.
A cold read by an agent with no context, shown only the rendered changelog, is an effective way to find vague phrasing; it flagged three phrases that were then reworded.
The courier agent's 200-character cap would flatten layered changesets, so they were drafted by hand and checked with a fresh reader instead.
Write PR bodies to a temp file and pass them with `gh pr edit --body-file` to avoid shell quoting problems.

friction: The courier agent's 200-character cap is too restrictive for layered changesets, so it could not be used to write them.
CI has not yet run on the PR; only local checks have been verified.
open_items: User needs to review PR #486 and read the three entries, since that is what users will see.
Once the plugin is updated, run the courier agent on the next changeset and compare its output with these hand-drafted ones.
#483's changeset and #485 were left unchanged and need no further work from this session.
